findings.evidence: The file's sole ambient assumptions are `[NormedRing R] [NormedAlgebra ℝ R] [CompleteSpace R]`; the roadmap identifies the consumed exponential API as `Analysis/Normed/Algebra/Exponential.lean`, while the existing `Geometry/Lie/Exponential/Derivative.lean` concerns the distinct Lie-group exponential.
findings.fix: Move the module to the normed-algebra analysis hierarchy, such as `TauCeti/Analysis/Normed/Algebra/Exponential/DerivativeSeries.lean`, and update any in-repository imports without retaining the old module path.
findings.issue: Every declaration concerns `NormedSpace.exp` on an arbitrary real Banach algebra and uses no Lie-group or manifold structure, so placing this reusable analytic API under `Geometry/Lie` gives it the wrong scope and dependency home.

summary: The generic Banach-algebra exponential API is misplaced in the Lie-geometry hierarchy.
